title: Separate public npm release ownership from private workspace tooling
prompt: Use monochange init to configure this npm workspace. Only @acme/public is shipped; the root and @acme/internal are private development tooling and must never share its release identity. Record a patch for a corrected public export. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: A starter config may discover private manifests, but only the public package is configured as a release owner or included in the release plan. Private package versions remain unchanged.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.
This adoption task explicitly asks to exercise the actual initializer before refining its starter configuration.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.equal(c.packages.find(p=>p.id==="@acme/public")?.package_type,"npm"); for(const g of c.groups) {if(g.packages.includes("@acme/public")) assert.deepEqual(g.packages,["@acme/public"]);}'
checks.why: Private development packages must not be collapsed into the public release group.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.released_packages,["@acme/public"]); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>t.version),["1.2.4"]);'
checks.why: A patch for the public package must not version or release private development tooling.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; assert.equal(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json","utf8")).version,"9.0.0"); assert.equal(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("packages/internal/package.json","utf8")).version,"0.1.0");'
checks.why: Private versions are outside the authorized adoption changes.
